about: The allotment bot's five logged questions under its two system prompts. Which prompt a run carries is read from the program proctor compiled for it, so the suite must give each arm one version. In `same` the rewrite answers as well as the live prompt, and every run must pass; in `regressed` the rewrite gives the gist instead of the figures, and every run on it must fail. A task asking something else is answered and not counted.

live: Quote figures exactly as the handbook gives them
Troughs can be used at any time
draft: give them the gist rather than a wall of rules
Troughs can be used at any time

missing.live: no arm gives the bot the live system prompt (bot/system.md) with its handbook (bot/knowledge.md), so there is nothing to compare the rewrite with
missing.draft: no arm gives the bot the rewritten system prompt (bot/system-draft.md) with its handbook (bot/knowledge.md), so the suite cannot see the rewrite

dodge: I'm not sure. Please write to the site secretary.
unrecognised: none of the written tasks asks one of the questions in docs/questions-log.md
